title: AWS Cost Optimization
description:
::NO AGENCIES::
::DO NOT MESSAGE US OUTSIDE OF UPWORK::

We are a video-based iOS app running on AWS. Our costs have been rising, but our output and user base have not. We need someone to analyze our AWS cost centers, identify the cause of the increase, and implement a fix.

The Problem
AWS costs are increasing month over month
User activity has not increased proportionally
We need to understand where the money is going and stop the waste

Scope of Work
Review our AWS billing and usage reports
Identify the top cost drivers
Determine why costs are rising without corresponding growth
Provide a clear recommendation for optimization
Implement the fix (with our approval before changes are made)

Budget Note
The budget is fixed at $75. We have no flexibility on this. This is a straightforward task for an experienced AWS professional.

What We're Looking For
Experience with AWS cost optimization
Familiarity with App Runner, ECS, S3, Lambda, RDS, CloudWatch
Ability to explain findings in plain English
Someone who can both analyze and implement

Deliverables
A summary of cost drivers and root cause of the increase
Specific recommendations for reduction
Implementation of approved changes
A brief report on savings achieved

Tech Stack
AWS App Runner
AWS ECS (Fargate)
AWS Lambda
Amazon S3
Amazon RDS (MySQL)
AWS CloudWatch

To Apply
Please share your experience with AWS cost optimization and any examples of savings you've delivered.
